legend: Enzo, a caveman, recently developed an interest in collecting stones as a hobby. He has a collection called A%%ZSMJ0%% with N%%ZSMJ1%% stones lined up in various colors and identified each color with an integer (for example, he defined color number 1%%ZSMJ2%% as the color green).

The special aspect of his collection is that, for a given number x%%ZSMJ3%%, he is very particular about what he calls the "kuga-buga-x%%ZSMJ4%% value"; this value is the number of colors that appear with a frequency that is a multiple of x%%ZSMJ5%%. For example, if he has 3%%ZSMJ6%% yellow stones and 6%%ZSMJ7%% blue stones, the kuga-buga-3%%ZSMJ8%% value is 2%%ZSMJ9%%, since he has two colors that appear a number of times that is a multiple of 3%%ZSMJ10%%.

Since he always wants to maintain the same number of stones but wants to keep the collection up to date, he frequently replaces stones he no longer likes with a new one of another color. He calls this update a type 1%%ZSMJ11%% query.
From time to time, he wonders about the kuga-buga value for a given number x%%ZSMJ12%%. He calls this question a type 2%%ZSMJ13%% query.
With that, Enzo wants your help to answer these kuga-buga queries given the stone collection A%%ZSMJ14%% and the updates that occur over time.
input: The first line of the input contains two integers N%%ZSMJ15%% (1≤N≤3⋅105)%%ZSMJ16%% and Q%%ZSMJ17%% (1≤Q≤105)%%ZSMJ18%%, the size of Enzo's collection and the number of queries, respectively.
The second line contains N%%ZSMJ19%% integers Ai%%ZSMJ20%% (1≤Ai≤106)%%ZSMJ21%%; the i%%ZSMJ22%%-th of these is the color of the stone at the i%%ZSMJ23%%-th position of A%%ZSMJ24%%.
The next Q%%ZSMJ25%% lines each contain a query.

A query can have one of two forms: "1%%ZSMJ26%% i%%ZSMJ27%% y%%ZSMJ28%%" (1≤i≤N, 1≤y≤106)%%ZSMJ29%% (replace the i%%ZSMJ30%%-th stone with one of color y%%ZSMJ31%%) or "2%%ZSMJ32%% x%%ZSMJ33%%" (1≤x≤106)%%ZSMJ34%% (what is the kuga-buga-x%%ZSMJ35%% value?).
output: For each query of type 2%%ZSMJ36%%, print the kuga-buga-x%%ZSMJ37%% value for the given value of x%%ZSMJ38%%.
